name: sleuthkit/autopsy
description: The premier open-source digital forensics platform providing a graphical interface to The Sleuth Kit and other tools. Used by law enforcement, military, and corporate examiners to investigate computers, recover deleted files, and analyze storage media.
score_rationale: Industry-standard open-source forensics workstation with 3.1k stars and active 2025 development, serving as the primary GUI-based disk forensics platform.
summary: Digital forensics and disk analysis platform
